;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Kashmir conflict]]
**Two Kashmiri civilians alleged to be [[Lashkar-e-Taiba]] militants are killed by [[Indian Army|Indian soldiers]] at [[Anantnag]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], in a [[counter-terrorism|counter]]-[[terrorism in India|terrorism]] operation. [https://www.dnaindia.com/india/report-jk-two-terrorists-affiliated-with-lashkar-e-taiba-gunned-down-in-south-kashmir-s-anantnag-2814523 (DNA India)] [https://arynews.tv/en/indian-troops-martyr-two-kashmiris-indian-occupied-kashmir/ (ARY News)]
*Five [[terrorism in Pakistan|terrorists]] are killed in [[Peshawar]], [[Khyber Paktunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]], by the Counter-Terrorism Department ([[Pakistan Army|CTD]]) in a heavy exchange of fire during a search operation. [https://www.geo.tv/latest/273607-ctd-kills-five-terrorists-in-security-operation-near-peshawar (Geo News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Nine people are killed and five injured after a vehicle fell into a deep gorge in [[Kathua District]], [[India]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-02/23/c_138809190.htm (Xinhua)]
*[[Stunt performer|Daredevil]] and [[flat Earth]] conspiracy theorist [[Mike Hughes (daredevil)|Mike Hughes]] dies after crashing in his homemade rocket near [[Barstow, California]]. He was attempting to prove the Earth was flat as part of a documentary series with [[Science Channel]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-51602655 (BBC News)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
***[[Italy]] confirms that a 78-year-old man in [[Padua]], [[Veneto]], and a woman in her 70s in [[Codogno]], [[Lombardy]], have died after contracting the virus. They are the first two coronavirus deaths in Italy. [https://www.tgcom24.mediaset.it/cronaca/coronavirus-nuovo-caso-di-contagio-in-veneto-un-67enne-di-dolo_15145712-202002a.shtml?refresh_cens (Tgcom24)]
***58 more coronavirus cases are confirmed in Italy, bringing the number of cases to 79. [https://www.open.online/2020/02/22/coronavirus-nuovo-caso-nel-padovano-19-contagiati-nel-nord-italia-tampone-in-corso-su-600-persone-tutti-gli-aggiornamenti/ (Open)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
***[[South Korea]] confirms that 229 more people have contracted the coronavirus in the country, raising the total number to 433. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-51596665 (BBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***The [[United States]] reports 34 confirmed cases of the illness and expects more. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/02/21/health/coronavirus-cases-usa.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iraq]]
***The first coronavirus case is confirmed in [[Iraq]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/iraq-reports-first-coronavirus-infection/1741593 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[Samoa]] bans all [[cruise ship]]s from visiting the country amid growing efforts to keep the virus away. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/410113/samoa-places-blanket-ban-on-cruise-ship-visits (RNZ)]

*[[France]] shuts down its first [[nuclear power]] [[nuclear reactor|reactor]], at the [[Fessenheim Nuclear Power Plant]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/france-shuts-down-first-reactor-of-fessenheim-nuclear-plant-near-german-border/a-52466064 (Deutsche Welle)]

;Law and crime
*Lesotho PM [[Tom Thabane]] is granted sick leave until 27 February when he is due to appear in court for the murder of his former wife. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lesotho-politics/lesotho-pm-granted-medical-leave-from-wife-murder-case-police-idUSKCN20G0FD (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Dominican Republic municipal elections]]
**The [[Politics of the Dominican Republic|Dominican Republic government]] wants the [[Organization of American States]] to investigate what occurred in the controversial February 16 elections. [https://dominicantoday.com/dr/local/2020/02/21/dominican-govt-wants-oas-probe-into-elections-fiasco/ (''Dominican Today'')] 
*[[2020 Togolese presidential election]]
**Voters in [[Togo]] head to the polls to elect the country's [[List of presidents of Togo|president]]. Incumbent president [[Faure Gnassingbé]], accused of an authoritarian rule, seeks to run for a fourth term which was made possible by a constitutional amendment in 2019. [https://www.dw.com/en/togo-goes-to-the-polls-as-ruling-family-seeks-sixth-decade-in-power/a-52474650 (DW)]
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**[[United States Senate|Senator]] [[Bernie Sanders]] wins the [[2020 Nevada Democratic caucuses|Nevada Caucus]]. [https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/nevada-caucuses-live-results-updates-2020/index.html (CNN)]
